biography:
I am a highly motivated professional with experience working in North America, Europe and the Middle East. I am a dynamic self-starter, passionate about my work, and fanatically devoted to solving problems. I have advised private companies and government organizations on innovative ways to optimize their businesses and scale for future growth. Transportation and Tech are my niche. 

I have been blessed with the opportunity to visit over 30 countries in my professional career, and work for two distinguished Judges. I enjoy meeting new people, chatting about new tech ventures, and debating global politics. My German use to be better, but I can still hold a conversation. 

My professional and personal experiences have taught me the following:

Accountability 
- Lead through action, talk is cheap.
- Customers always come first; they pay the bills. 

People 
- Leadership is about inspiration not intimidation. 
- Acknowledgement and thanks breed productivity. 

 My Favorite Quote! 
"TIME is the one thing constantly moving, the same thing we want to pause, yet the last thing we ever want to end. Don't waste it!"
